thread:
Priya (ML): FYI int8 bring-up for q3b showing odd token-level diffs on our snippetbank. pushing a 30-sample export.
Diego (Curation): saw the alert in the dashboard. are diffs mainly whitespace or semantic?
Priya (ML): mix — whitespace normalization and occasional var-name-case changes (e.g., myVar -> myvar). BLEU/ROUGE down ~9% on compact-golden.
Hannah (Labeling): can labelers focus on snippet formatting and varname-morph tags? we can do a fast pass.
eval-bot: Exported 30 items to queue q://curation/snippet-relab-172222
Theo (Infra): sampler-main under embed load; recommend routing to sampler-edge for short batches. set batch_size=4 to avoid OOM.
Diego (Curation): we'll run a dedupe pass first; propose similarity cutoff 0.95 for this run so we avoid dropping subtle variants.
Hannah (Labeling): will add guidance: preserve original casing, do not auto-normalize identifiers, keep leading/trailing newlines. confidence=high/med/low on each label.
Priya (ML): triage steps: (1) relabel flagged examples, (2) run int8 vs fp A/B with cache-cold and cache-warm, (3) run a varname-diff detector and tag results.
Diego (Curation): adding automation: tag if token_diff > 15 or varname_changes > 0 -> mark candidate for relabel.
Theo (Infra): routed to sampler-edge, batch_size=4, note retry_policy=1. ops recorded.
Hannah (Labeling): started batch; ETA ~1.75h for first pass. small note: 5 examples look like ingest trimmed trailing comments -> flagging as ingest-normalize.
Priya (ML): good catch. Diego, can we exclude ingest-normalize cases from metric delta? they pollute signal.
Diego (Curation): yes; will filter those before computing recovery. will also archive originals into archived-snippets before swap.
eval-bot: Canary A/B job 172222-canary queued. will run after relabel batch completes.
Priya (ML): success criteria: recovery >=8% on compact-golden OR varname-morph rate <1% -> proceed with staged golden update; else rollback int8 profile.
Hannah (Labeling): update: 12/30 relabeled high-confidence, 6 med, 12 low. tagging high-confidence for immediate patch candidates.
Theo (Infra): canary started 172222-canary. monitoring in #eng-ml-canary.
Priya (ML): thanks. please surface any hallucinated imports or added top-level statements separately — those are higher-severity.
Diego (Curation): noted. will include halluc-import tag. will post final diff table when canary finishes.
summary: Coordination for int8 model bring-up showing identifier-case and whitespace regressions on snippetbank. Actions: dedupe(0.95), sampler routing, relabeling with confidence, varname-morph and ingestion tags, canary A/B, and staged golden swap criteria.
